She must have expected me to still be asleep, because the sight of me awake brought a flicker of surprise to her face.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: 胸のあたりがムカムカして describes nausea churning around Shiki's chest; 'my chest hurts' replaces it with pain. In a character with a chest scar, cardiac strain, and recurrent anemia, chest pain is a materially different physical cue and causal signal. Retaining 'feel sick' does not cancel the invented pain.

　先輩は一瞬にして、あの無表情な目をして見つめてきた。
　……言いにくい。
言いにくいけど、はっきり言うために追ってきたんだ。
lines.label: s281
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――Ugh.”
In an instant, she was watching me with those expressionless eyes again.
This would be hard to say. But I had followed her precisely because I meant to say it plainly.

…… It's hard to speak.
It's hard to speak, but this is why I came after her.

先輩はさんざん止めろって言ってくれたけど、やっぱり俺は吸血鬼の事は放っておけないんだ」
　……うっ。
無表情だった先輩の目が、なんか激しく怒ってる。
lines.label: s281
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hear me out before you get angry. You warned me over and over to stay away, but I still can’t ignore the vampire.”
Ouch. Her eyes had been expressionless; now they were silently, furiously angry.

「……とにかく、吸血鬼の事は放っておけない。
けど、昨日のことでアルクェイドとは決裂しちゃって、俺には何かをしたくても手段がないんだ。
　だから―――先輩が吸血鬼を探してるっていうんなら、それに協力させてくれないか」
　……先輩は黙っている。
　そうして、はあ、と深くため息をついて、
「イヤです」
　なんて、笑顔で断言した。
lines.label: s281
lines.maoEnglish:
“I can’t ignore the vampire. But after what happened yesterday, Arcueid and I are finished, and I have no way to act even if I want to.
So―――if you’re hunting the vampire too, will you let me help?”
She said nothing.
Then she released a long, weary sigh and—
“No.”
She refused me with a smile.

lines.japanese:
「イヤですって、なんで！？」
「あったりまえじゃないですかっ！
　遠野くん、昨日の夜だって彼女に殺されかけたって自覚してないんですか！？
　吸血鬼を追うっていうのは、いつ殺されてもおかしくないぐらい危険な事なんです。
そんな事に遠野くんを引き込むなんてできません！」
「―――だから、そういうのは覚悟の上だって言ってるだろ！
　これでも散々死ぬような目にあってきたんだ。
自分の身ぐらい自分で守れる！」
lines.label: s281
lines.maoEnglish:
“Why would you say no!?”
“Because it’s obvious! Tohno, don’t you understand that she nearly killed you last night!?
Hunting a vampire is so dangerous that death can come at any moment. I can’t drag you into something like that!”
“―――I keep telling you, I’m prepared for that! I’ve already survived more brushes with death than I can count. I can look after myself!”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"You refuse?

"Of course I would!

I will not let you be involved in such a thing, Tohno-kun!"
"---I know, but I'm saying I'm prepared for that!
I might not look like it, but I've experienced many near-death situations.
I can at least protect myself!"

「……あのですね。
遠野くん、なにを根拠にそんなコト言ってるんですか。
　確かに遠野くんの運動神経がいいのは認めます。
遠野くんは病弱ですけど、肉体そのものは優れているってわかってますから」
　肩をすくめて、先輩は意外なことを口にする。
「……そ、そうなの？」
　毒気を抜かれてしまって、つい聞き返してしまった。
lines.label: s281
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Tell me, Tohno, what possible grounds do you have for claiming that?
I admit your reflexes are excellent. You may be sickly, but I know your body itself is exceptionally capable.”
She shrugged and offered this unexpected assessment.
“R-really?”
The fight went out of me so completely that I couldn’t help asking.

"…… Um, Tohno-kun.
How can you say that?
I will admit that you have very good athletic abilities.
Even though you have a weak constitution, your body itself is excellent."
Slumping her shoulders, Senpai says something very surprising.
"…… R, really?"
The tension seems to disappear, and I blurt that out in response.

lines.japanese:
「ええ。
遠野くん、わたしの部屋に泊まったとき裸になったじゃないですか。
その時に見たんです。
贅肉のない、引き締まった筋肉をしてました。
　遠くからでしたけど、その時にキレイな躯しているなあって思ったぐらいです」
「……裸って――――俺、裸になんかなってないけど」
「忘れちゃったんですか？
　遠野くん、お風呂に入るとき台所で着替えてたじゃないですか」
　あ、そうだった。
　たしか脱衣場に洗濯物が干してあって、邪魔になるからって―――
lines.label: s281
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yes. When you stayed at my place, you got undressed, remember? I saw you then. Your muscles were lean and firm, without any extra fat.
Even from a distance, I thought you had a beautiful body.”
“Undressed――――I never got naked.”
“Have you forgotten? You changed in the kitchen before your bath.”
Oh, right.
The changing area had been full of drying laundry, so she’d said it would get in the way―――

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.

"Did you forget?
Tohno-kun, did you not change before you entered the bath?"
Ah, that's right.
Certainly I did take off my clothes and had her wash them for me---

“I had no idea. So you were the kind of person who spied on someone while he changed.”
“―――N-no, that was beyond my control; I happened to see you through the gap and was just a little curious, so I thought one tiny look wouldn’t hurt.”
Her face grew redder with every word of her defense.
Apparently the explanation had made her relive the scene.

I drew my knife—

She extended one hand.

Choosing the Far East was a mere whim. Perhaps after seventeen repetitions of a life in which nothing ever changed, I simply craved some novel stimulus.”

「一つの肉体に二つのイシは入らない。

Simple: the brain, the vessel, screams.
Headaches. They come for no reason, without meaning, without warning.”
“―――――”
Headache, could he possibly mean―――

lines.japanese:
「そうだよ。
オマエの頭痛は、オレからオマエに流れているものだ。
　言っただろう？
　オマエの命はオレが使っている。
オレたちはさ、一つの命を取り合って生きているんだ。
　だから―――オレがこうして活動すれば、オマエは死体みたいに動けなくなるっていうワケだ。
　イシを殺すものはイシだからな。
オマエの生きようとするイシより、オレの生きようっていうイシのほうが強い」
「……まあ、それでもたいしたもんだ。
オレは殺すつもりでオマエの動力を使っているんだが……おかしいな、どうしてオマエは生きているんだろう」
　ヤツは本気で首をかしげている。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“That’s right. The pain in your head flows from me into you.
I told you, didn’t I? I’m using your life. The two of us live by fighting over a single life.
So―――whenever I’m active, you’re left unable to move, like a corpse.
Only a will can kill another will. My will to live is stronger than yours.”
“Still, you’ve done remarkably well. I’m drawing on your power with every intention of killing you, yet somehow you’re still alive.”
He tilted his head in genuine puzzlement.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"That's right.

Didn't I say so earlier?
I am using your life.
We are two people using the same life.

What kills a will is another will.
My will to live is stronger than yours."
"…… Well, but you are still amazing.
I'm using your strength trying to kill you…… But that's strange, why are you still alive?"
As he tilts his head, he really does look perplexed.

オマエのことが好きだったぜ。

けどな、遠野の人間は特殊なんだ。

　反転衝動というのかな。

　オレは心のどこかでオマエに嫉妬していたんだろうさ。

In that courtyard, Roa killed my will.
Ordinarily that would have ended with Roa awakening. But the Tohnos are different.
Once my reason was gone, the body inverted.
An inversion impulse, I suppose. You rush first to do everything you once considered taboo.
Somewhere inside, I must have envied you. In the end, I killed you simply because you happened to be there.”

lines.japanese:
「まったく、あの時以上の快感はなかったぜ！
　この手をオマエの胸につっこんでさあ、心臓を抉り出した時の嘔吐感っていったら、もういっきに生まれ変わるんじゃないかって思うぐらいだった！
　それがあんまりにも気持ち気持ちイイもんでさ、もう少しオマエの体で遊ぼうって思ってたのが運の尽きだったんだがね。
　オレがオマエの心臓をキレイにしようって躍起になっている時にさ、誰かがオレとオマエの事を親父に密告しやがった。
　親父のヤロウ、駆けつけてくるなりオレのことを殺しやがった！
　実の息子のこのオレをだぜ！？
　　ったく、酷い親父もいたもんだ。
あんなんじゃ息子にくびり殺されても文句は言えないよな志貴！
　まあ最後は――わりとスカッとしたけどな」
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“Nothing has ever felt better than that!
I plunged this hand into your chest, and when I gouged out your heart, the urge to vomit was so overwhelming I thought I might be reborn on the spot!
It felt good, good, GOOD, so good that I decided to play with your body a little longer; that was my mistake.
While I was obsessed with cleaning up your heart, somebody ran and told Father about us.
The bastard came charging in and killed me on sight! His own son!? What a monstrous father. He had no right to complain when his son finally strangled him to death, did he, Shiki!?
Though in the end――it did feel pretty damn good.”
lines.mao_english:
“Nothing has ever felt better than that!

It felt good, good, GOOD, so good that I decided to play with your body a little longer; that was my mistake.
While I was obsessed with cleaning up your heart, somebody ran and told Father about us.
The bastard came charging in and killed me on sight! His own son!? What a monstrous father. He had no right to complain when his son finally strangled him to death, did he, Shiki!?
Though in the end――it did feel pretty damn good.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Man, there never was a pleasure greater than that time!
Piercing your chest with this hand and feeling your heart as you coughed up blood.
I thought I was born again!
It felt so wonderful, I stood there wanting to play with your dying body even longer, but I was pushing my luck.
While I was eagerly trying to rip out your heart, someone informed the old man.
That bastard, he rushed over and killed me!
Me, his real son!
Shit.
I guess cruel fathers do exist.
A father like that can't complain when he's killed by his own son, right, Shiki!?
Well in the end--I felt pretty good."

　イシの強いほうが命を使うんだろう。
　なら―――俺は今まで。
　こんなに強く、一つのことを思ったことは、ない。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
There was no need to explain.
The stronger will was the one that got to use the life.
Then―――until this moment.
Never once had I wanted a single thing this fiercely.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
There's no need to say it.
The one with the stronger will uses the life, right?
Then---up until now,
I never thought this strongly about anything before.
lines.mirror_moon:
There's no need to say it.

lines.japanese:
「嘘だ。
オレが―――オレのほうが弱いっていうのか、オマエより……！」
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish: “That’s a lie. I―――I’m weaker than you…!?”
lines.mao_english: “That’s a lie. I―――I’m weaker than you…!?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"This can't be!
Am---am I weaker than you……!?"
lines.mirror_moon:
"This can't be!
Am---am I weaker than you……!?"

lines.japanese:
ロア。
オマエを殺してやる。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish: Roa. I will kill you.
lines.mao_english: Roa. I will kill you.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Roa.
I'm going to kill you.
lines.mirror_moon:
Roa.
I'm going to kill you.

lines.japanese:
闇の中で。
　ナイフと、ロアの爪とが交錯する。
　ロアの動きは見えないぐらいに速い。
　けれど、体が付いていく。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
In the darkness.
My knife crossed Roa’s claws.
He moved too fast for the eye to follow.
My body kept pace anyway.
lines.mao_english:
In the darkness.
My knife crossed Roa’s claws.
He moved too fast for the eye to follow.
My body kept pace anyway.
lines.mirrorMoon:
In the darkness,
My knife crosses against his claws.
His movement is almost blindingly fast.
But, my body follows him.
lines.mirror_moon:
In the darkness,
My knife crosses against his claws.
His movement is almost blindingly fast.
But, my body follows him.

lines.japanese:
腕が別の生き物のように動く。
　眼球は的確に執拗に確実に残酷に、ヤツの『線』だけを捉えていく。
　全身が熱い。
　頭蓋が焼ける。
　初めて―――あの金髪の吸血姫を見た時のように、体中が別物になっている。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
My arm moved like a creature of its own.
Relentlessly, precisely, certainly, cruelly, my eyes caught nothing but the lines on his body.
Heat filled me.
My skull burned.
My whole body had become something else, just as it had the first time―――when I saw that blond vampire princess.
lines.mao_english:

Heat filled me.
My skull burned.

lines.mirrorMoon:
My arms move as if they belonged to someone else.
My eyes persistently, accurately look at just his "lines".
My entire body burns.
My brain feels like it is on fire.
Just like---when I first saw that golden-haired princess of the vampires, my body is like something else.
lines.mirror_moon:

My eyes persistently, accurately look at just his "lines".
My entire body burns.

lines.japanese:
「チッ――――！」
　ロアが離れる。
　その片足。
右腕上腕部分。
鎖骨の左あたり。
　それら三つの『線』は、すでに切断してある。
　代償はこちらの右腕。
　ロアは俺のナイフを持つ腕をまず潰した。
　だから、こっちは残った左腕を潰されれば負けというコトになる。
　この場合、負けというのは即死を意味する。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“Tch――――!”
Roa sprang away.
One leg. His upper right arm. The left side of his collarbone.
I had already severed the three lines crossing those places.
The price was my right arm.
Roa had destroyed the arm holding the knife first.
If he destroyed my remaining left arm, I would lose.
Here, losing meant instant death.

In this situation, losing means certain death.

lines.japanese:
「―――まさかな。
吸血種であるオレと互角か。
　……おまえのその目は、ある意味オレ以上に私に相応しい業なのかもしれない」
「――――」
「気づかないのならいいさ。
ああ、これは語るまでもないつまらない話なんだから」
　じり、と。
　ロアの体が、間合いを外していく。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――Impossible. You can fight a vampiric creature like me to a draw.
In a certain sense, those eyes of yours may be a burden more fitting for me than my own.”
“――――”
“If you haven’t noticed, never mind. It is a trivial story, hardly worth telling.”
Inch by inch.
Roa withdrew beyond my reach.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"---I don't believe it.
A match for me, a vampire.
…… your eyes, they are perhaps more appropriate for me than this body."
"----"
"If you don't realize it, then that's fine.
This story is a boring one not even worth talking about."
With a shuffle,
Roa increases the distance between us.

lines.japanese:
「……大昔の話さ。
永遠を生きるという事を考えすぎた愚かものの末路だよ。
それを手にいれたのは、結局どちらだったのかなってコトさ」
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish: “An ancient story. The fate of a fool who thought too long about living forever. I merely wonder which of us attained it in the end.”
lines.mao_english: “An ancient story. The fate of a fool who thought too long about living forever. I merely wonder which of us attained it in the end.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's a very old story.
The last of a fool who obsessed over living forever.
Just wondering who it was that actually won that."
lines.mirror_moon:
"…… It's a very old story.
The last of a fool who obsessed over living forever.
Just wondering who it was that actually won that."

lines.japanese:
「―――永遠を生きる。
　それがロアが夢見た奇跡だ。
　私は輪廻転生することこそが永遠とした。
　だがね、そんなものは一つの血族を延々と続けていくのと変わりはないのさ。
　死を受け入れたロアというモノの子孫が最後に得る力があるとすれば―――それは吸血種として他者の命を奪う、というものではなく。
　……少年。
オマエのような死を視る力こそ、死に挑んだ私に相応しい果てではなかったのか、とな」
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――To live forever.
That was the miracle Roa dreamed of.
I took reincarnation itself for eternity.
But that differs little from perpetuating a single bloodline without end.
If the descendants of Roa, the thing that accepted death, were ever to attain a final power―――it should not have been the vampiric power to steal another’s life.
Boy. Perhaps a power like yours—the power to see death—was the end truly fitting for one who challenged death.”
lines.mao_english:
“―――To live forever.
That was the miracle Roa dreamed of.
I took reincarnation itself for eternity.
But that differs little from perpetuating a single bloodline without end.
If the descendants of Roa, the thing that accepted death, were ever to attain a final power―――it should not have been the vampiric power to steal another’s life.
Boy. Perhaps a power like yours—the power to see death—was the end truly fitting for one who challenged death.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"---To live forever.
That was the miracle that Roa dreamed about.
I decided that an everlasting cycle of rebirth is eternity.
But that is no different than a continuation of a single bloodline.
If there is such a thing as a power that Roa, who accepted death, can earn at the end of his reincarnation---instead of the power that steals the lives of others like vampires.
…… I just thought the power you have, the power to see death, was an appropriate end for me."

lines.label: s283

lines.japanese: 「そのような、下らぬ感傷を抱いただけだ！」
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish: “Nothing more than a worthless fit of sentiment!”
lines.mao_english: “Nothing more than a worthless fit of sentiment!”
lines.mirrorMoon: "I just had that ridiculous idea!"
lines.mirror_moon: "I just had that ridiculous idea!"

lines.japanese:
ロアの腕が伸びる。
　それを、咄嗟に切り返した。
「ぐっ―――！」
　ロアが逃げる。
　それを追う。
　ロアの動きは、俺なんかの何倍も早い。
　けど、そんなことは、あまり問題じゃなかった。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
Roa’s arm shot out.
Instinctively, I slashed it aside.
“Ghh―――!”
Roa fled.
I pursued him.
Roa moved many times faster than I could.
But that no longer mattered very much.

lines.mirrorMoon:

"Gah---!"

I follow after him.

ただ殺す。
　それ以外のことなんて、どうでもいい。
　事実。
　とっくにロアの片足を殺して、ヤツの動きは半減させている。
　ロアは逃げながら。
　壁に手をついて、俺を睨んだ。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
Kill him.
Nothing else mattered.
The fact was simple.
I had already killed one of his legs and cut his speed in half.
Roa kept fleeing.
He braced a hand against the wall and glared at me.

lines.japanese:
「チクショウ―――自分と戦おうっていうのか、志貴」
「――――――」
「黙るな……！
　オマエはオレだ。
オマエもシキならオレだってシキだ。
　オレたちはな、似たもの同士だ。
ロアなんてヤロウはいてもいなくても変わらない。
　……オレはもともと人食いの変種でね、ガキの頃から人の肉を食いたいって衝動があった。
今じゃ血なんていう物足りないものが主食になっちまったが、ロアが入ってこなかったら間違いなく人食いの化け物になってたさ」
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“Damn you―――are you really going to fight yourself, Shiki?”
“――――――”
“Don’t just stand there in silence! You are me. If you are Shiki, then so am I.
We’re the same kind. Whether the bastard Roa existed or not would have changed nothing.
I was born a mutant cannibal who had wanted to eat human flesh since childhood. These days I have to live on something as unsatisfying as blood, but without Roa I would unquestionably have become a man-eating monster.”

“Damn you―――are you really going to fight yourself, Shiki?”

I was born a mutant cannibal who had wanted to eat human flesh since childhood. These days I have to live on something as unsatisfying as blood, but without Roa I would unquestionably have become a man-eating monster.”

"------"
"Don't be silent……!
You're me.
I am SHIKI, and you are Shiki.
We are the same type of being.
It doesn't matter if that bastard Roa existed or not.
…… I was originally a creature eating human flesh.
As a child, I had this urge to eat human flesh.
Even though that has changed to drinking blood, if Roa hadn't entered my body, I would've certainly become a human eating monster."

「―――だがな、それはオマエも同じだ。
　オレが人食いに悦楽するようにさ、オマエも人殺しがスキなんだよ！
　思い出せ、オマエがあの女を初めて見た時の衝動を、そのナイフで色んなモノを殺してきたあとの恍惚を！」
「――――――」
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――And you are no different.
I delight in eating people, and you delight in killing them! Remember the urge you felt when you first saw that woman and the ecstasy after you killed all those things with your knife!”
“――――――”
lines.mao_english:

I delight in eating people, and you delight in killing them! Remember the urge you felt when you first saw that woman and the ecstasy after you killed all those things with your knife!”
“――――――”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"---But, that's the same for you.
Like I enjoy eating human flesh, you enjoy killing others!
Remember the urge you had when you first saw that woman, the ecstasy of killing with that knife!"
"------"

初めてあの女を見た時の衝動――――？
　それは―――アルクェイドを殺した時のコトか。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
The urge I felt when I first saw her――――?
Did he mean―――when I killed Arcueid?
lines.mao_english:
The urge I felt when I first saw her――――?
Did he mean―――when I killed Arcueid?
lines.mirrorMoon:
The urge I had when I first saw her----
That was---when I killed Arcueid.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「ああそうだ。
オマエがどんなにイイ子ぶってもな、アレだけは言い訳がきかねえよ。
オマエはあの女に欲情して、オマエが一番興奮する手段でサバいたんじゃねえか。
　これが殺人鬼じゃなくてなんだっていうんだ。
　オレとオマエは、所詮同じイキモノ―――同じトコロに棲んでいる異常者なのさ」
「――――――」
　……うるさい。
　これ以上コイツの声を聞いていると、おかしくなる。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. Pretend to be a good little boy all you like, but there is no excusing that. You lusted after her, then butchered her in the way that excited you most.
If that does not make you a murderer, what does?
You and I are the same creature in the end―――deviants who dwell in the same place.”
“――――――”
Shut up.
If I listened to him any longer, I would lose my mind.
lines.mao_english:
“Exactly. Pretend to be a good little boy all you like, but there is no excusing that. You lusted after her, then butchered her in the way that excited you most.
If that does not make you a murderer, what does?
You and I are the same creature in the end―――deviants who dwell in the same place.”
“――――――”
Shut up.
If I listened to him any longer, I would lose my mind.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, that's right.
No matter how much you pretend to be a good person, that's something you can't excuse.
You wanted that woman and did the thing that got you the most excited.
What can you call that other than being a killer?
You and I are the same---we are both abnormal people living in the same place."
"------"
…… Shut up.
If I hear his voice any longer, I'll go crazy.

ロアが叫ぶ。
　八年間。
　この街に巣くって、何人もの人間の血を吸ってきた化け物が叫ぶ。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
Roa screamed.
For eight years.
The monster that had infested this city and drunk the blood of countless people screamed.

lines.japanese:
「―――おまえは俺じゃない。
つまらない、ただの人殺しだ」
「ハッ、わかってないな。
オレだって初めはそう思ってた。
オレはマトモだ。
ロアの意思があってもきっと大丈夫だってな。
　けどダメだった。
オマエも同じさ。
オマエも、オレと同じ、ただの人殺しになりさがるんだよ、遠野志貴！」
　おかしそうにロアは笑う。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――You aren’t me. You’re nothing but a petty murderer.”
“Ha! You don’t understand. I thought that way at first too. I told myself I was sane, that even with Roa’s will inside me, I would be fine.
I wasn’t. You’ll be the same. You’ll sink into being nothing but a murderer, just like me, Shiki Tohno!”
Roa laughed as though it were all terribly amusing.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Elesia believed helping her father, attending school, and ordinary unrequited love were both the duty imposed on her and the happiness naturally permitted to her. mirror moon collapses this moral architecture into 'that was my life,' losing the contrast between obligation and authorized happiness before both are taken away.

evidence.japanese:
私は、今までの自分の計算高さを嗤った。
　家柄など、いくらでも後から作ることができる。
　だが肉体の素質だけは、後付けのきかない天性の物に他ならない。
　こと十七回目の転生にして、私はようやくその真実にたどり着いた。
evidence.japaneseHighlight: 今までの自分の計算高さを嗤った
evidence.label: s283
evidence.mirrorMoon:
I cursed my calculating self up until now.
Things like social standing, they could always be set up later.
But the quality of the body is something natural that cannot be added later.
After my seventeenth reincarnation, I finally realized that truth.
evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: I cursed my calculating self

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Roa scoffs or laughs at the calculating caution of his prior reincarnations after discovering bodily potential matters more than family status. mirror moon says he cursed himself, replacing contemptuous superiority with anger or regret.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: Roa laughs at his calculating former selves instead of cursing them

lines.japanese:
目覚めた私は、ごく自然に、水が地面を浸食していくように、ひそやかに街の人々を配下にくわえていった。
　けれどその手段は今までのように乱暴ではなく、むしろあまり血を流さないものだった。
　理由は、ひどく残酷なものである。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
Once awake, I quietly gathered the townspeople beneath me as naturally as water eating into earth.
Yet my methods were less violent than before, and shed remarkably little blood.
The reason was unspeakably cruel.
lines.mao_english:
Once awake, I quietly gathered the townspeople beneath me as naturally as water eating into earth.
Yet my methods were less violent than before, and shed remarkably little blood.
The reason was unspeakably cruel.
lines.mirrorMoon:
My self that finally awoke naturally started to control the people around me like water soaking into the ground.
Not in the wild manner I had done so previously, but rather in a way that didn't spill as much blood.
The reason is horribly cruel.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
転生した私という意識は、それ単体では存在できない。
　あるのは『～をこうしたい』という意思だけである。
　今、この肉体を動かしているのは私だが、その過程・方法を選ぶのは肉体として育ち、肉体とともに形成された精神であるわたしだった。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
The reincarnated consciousness called Roa could not exist by itself.
It possessed only a will: the desire to make some particular thing happen.
Roa was the force moving this body, but the mind that chose each means and method was mine—the mind raised within the body and shaped alongside it.
lines.mao_english:
The reincarnated consciousness called Roa could not exist by itself.
It possessed only a will: the desire to make some particular thing happen.
Roa was the force moving this body, but the mind that chose each means and method was mine—the mind raised within the body and shaped alongside it.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The reincarnated will called myself cannot exist by itself.
All I can do is tell the will "I want to do that."
I am the one moving this body, but the method, the process was determined by my mind which has grown along with this body.

mirrorMoonErrors.title: Roa's will as pure intention becomes a self giving orders to 'the will'

lines.japanese:
つまり―――わたしは意思だけは私という転生体のものであるが、意識はもとのわたしのままなのだ。
　わたしの意識はあり、記憶も確かにある。
　わたしは眠ったまま、自分が犯す悪夢を見続けることしかできない。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
Thus―――the will belonged to the reincarnated entity called Roa, while the consciousness remained my own.
My awareness endured; my memories remained intact.
Trapped in sleep, I could do nothing but watch the nightmare my own body committed.
lines.mao_english:
Thus―――the will belonged to the reincarnated entity called Roa, while the consciousness remained my own.
My awareness endured; my memories remained intact.
Trapped in sleep, I could do nothing but watch the nightmare my own body committed.
lines.mirrorMoon:
In other words---my will is from the body I am reincarnated into, but my consciousness still remains from my original self.
I have my consciousness, and I have my past memories.
As I sleep, I could only dream of nightmares which I would do myself.

lines.japanese:
覚えている。
　両親の喉に食いついた時の感触を。
　わたしに笑顔を向けてくれた街の人たちを一人一人、じっくりと足元から熔かすように、その魂を陵辱し続けた日々を。
　わたしは、たった一月で。
　街の人たちの命を掌の上に乗せて、ただ己の快楽のためだけに弄ぶようになった。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
I remember.
The feel of my parents’ throats between my teeth.
I remember the days I spent violating the souls of the townspeople who had smiled at me, one by one, slowly, as though melting them from the feet upward.
Within a single month.
I held all their lives in my palm and toyed with them solely for my own pleasure.
lines.mao_english:
I remember.
The feel of my parents’ throats between my teeth.
I remember the days I spent violating the souls of the townspeople who had smiled at me, one by one, slowly, as though melting them from the feet upward.
Within a single month.
I held all their lives in my palm and toyed with them solely for my own pleasure.
lines.mirrorMoon:
I still remember.
The sensation of biting into my parents' throats.
I took the townspeople who always greeted me, one by one.
as if melting them slowly from their feet, I continued to humiliate and mutilate their souls.
Within just a month.
I held their lives in my fist and played with them however I wanted to.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
いっそ、狂いたかった。
　狂って、全てを私にゆだねたかった。
　けれどそうすれば、わたしは今以上の罪を犯すだろう。
　わたしは、ずっと。
　このまま正気を保ち続けて、せめて私の行為が最小限に収まるように生きるしかない。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
I wished I could go mad.
I wanted madness to let me surrender everything to him.
But if I did, I knew I would commit even greater sins.
All that time.
I had to preserve my sanity and live so that Roa’s crimes might at least be kept to a minimum.
lines.mao_english:
I wished I could go mad.
I wanted madness to let me surrender everything to him.
But if I did, I knew I would commit even greater sins.
All that time.
I had to preserve my sanity and live so that Roa’s crimes might at least be kept to a minimum.
lines.mirrorMoon:
I wanted to go crazy.
I wanted to entrust myself completely to insanity.
But if I did that, I would commit even more sins than before.
That's why I kept on.
Trying to preserve my sanity, I tried to minimize the damage I did.

lines.japanese:
わたしは知らない。
　けれど私はそれが誰であるか解っていた。
　戦いの末、白い吸血姫はわたしを仕留めた。
　すでに転生の準備を進めていた私はまたも転生し、あとに残されたのはわたしの遺体だけとなる。
　白い女は去り、わたしの遺体は、法王庁に運ばれた。
lines.label: s283
lines.maoEnglish:
I, the girl, did not know her.
But Roa knew exactly who she was.
At the end of the battle, the white vampire princess killed me.
Roa had already begun preparing another reincarnation and departed once more, leaving behind only my corpse.
The woman in white left, and my body was taken to the Holy See.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
I didn't know.
But I knew who she was.
After our fight, the white vampire princess killed me.
Since I had already prepared myself for the next reincarnation, I once again reincarnated, leaving my corpse behind.
The white princess left and my body was taken to the Vatican.

lines.japanese:
メルシー！
　なんだかあんまりなデッドエンドを迎えてしまったついてない遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
　それではニ時間目の授業を始めます。
lines.label: s522
lines.maoEnglish:
Merci!
It’s time for Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for unlucky Tohno,
who has met with a truly appalling dead end.
Let’s begin lesson two.

lines.japanese:
ははあ、これは原因ははっきりしていますねー。
　逃がした魚は大きいというか、大事な先輩なんですからとことんまで話をして和解しちゃいましょう。
　一人では勝てない相手も、二人の愛の力でラクショーです。
　アルクェイドの助けなんて必要ありません！
lines.label: s522
lines.maoEnglish:
I see—the cause is perfectly obvious.
The one who got away was quite a catch—or rather, she is your precious upperclassman, so keep talking until the two of you make peace.
An enemy you cannot defeat alone is easy prey before the power of your love.
You certainly do not need Arcueid’s help!

lines.mirrorMoon:
I see, there is a distinct reason for this.
The fish that got away this time is big.
It's your dear Senpai, so talk your heart out with her and make peace with her.
Even if it's an opponent you can't beat by yourself, it's easy using the power of love between two people.
You don't need Arcueid's help at all!
